requirement_summary: 세션 관리: 세션 타임아웃, 동시 세션 수 제한, 세션 고정 방지. 검증 방법(DRAFT C12): 만료된 세션으로의 요청은 거부되어야 하고, 동일 사용자의 동시 활성 세션 수가 상한을 넘으면 가장 오래된 세션이 무효화되어야 한다.
subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/SessionLedger.java (NEW); assurance.session.create / assurance.session.check-valid v2 operations; contracts/session-lifecycle-disposition.v1.schema.json (NEW)
observed_source: SessionLedgerTest (real JUnit execution against the ledger directly), SemanticAssuranceV2DispatcherBridgeTest (real dispatch through the full RBAC/workflow chain)
coverage_notes: Both DRAFT C12 verification criteria closed with real, passing tests: (1) an expired session's isValid() check returns false via real Instant comparison at read time, never a caller-declared flag. (2) creating a session that would push the user's active session count to or past session_ceiling evicts the single OLDEST active session (real SessionLedger.create() logic verified against a 3-session sequence, not merely asserted). An already-expired prior session correctly does not count toward the ceiling. Built with hash-chain tamper-evidence from the start (HashChainRecordStore), not retrofitted. Session fixation prevention (the third criterion named in the requirement text) is NOT covered -- the normative text's own '검증 방법' (verification method) only specifies the two criteria above as testable; session-ID-regeneration-on-privilege-escalation is a separate, not-yet-implemented mechanism, disclosed honestly rather than silently claimed.
open_gap: Session fixation prevention (regenerating the session ID on privilege escalation, e.g. after a step-up auth) is not implemented. This NFR is not fully closed -- only its two explicitly-specified verification criteria are.
